items.statement: A four-molecule, same-S1 TD/NTO/IFCT comparison quantifies LE/CT mixing and both Me/CF3 and AC/ACFy substitution effects, supported by mapped ground-state geometry and orbitals. The conclusion must follow the actual quantitative results and distinguish source agreement, deviations and method-sensitive small trends; it does not prove device efficiency or RISC kinetics.
